AnyAPI.Description: Native mod framework for Anymaker 0.1.25; loads mod bundles (several mods in one DLL, each switchable in Mod Settings) and adds menu v4.

AnyEngineParts.Description: Engine parts and sound in one mod: turbochargers and belt-driven superchargers with blow-off valves, wastegate, antilag and launch control, oil ports, air filters, intercoolers, a Dyno sensor and a 1-4 rotor rotary engine; EngineSound's generated engine sounds; and the GPS Sensor part. Each piece can be switched off in Mod Settings. Anymaker 0.1.25 only.

AnyHelpers.Description: Building and editing helpers in one mod: Mod Controls and Mod Settings, Duplicate tool favorites and a host ADMIN tab, AnyInventory's item search, AnyMirror's mirrored building, AnyBalance's centre of mass, and MCCode's Code view for microcontrollers. Each piece can be switched off in Mod Settings. Anymaker 0.1.25 only.

AnyGraphics.Description: Graphics overhaul with presets from Off to Cinematic plus Custom, TAA, tone mapping and colour looks, shading, shadows, sky, depth of field, motion blur and photo mode, plus ThirdPerson's F5 third-person camera. Each piece can be switched off in Mod Settings. Anymaker 0.1.25 only.

AnyMap.Description: World map and minimap with route placement and zoom; shows vehicles, zombies and creatures with a map key. Ready to carry more map pieces as one mod. Anymaker 0.1.25 only.
